title: Call one more person
summary: The Responsável adds a named person, on the phone, with both phones in one place (ADR 0251). The Responsável shows the code and the person scans it. The Responsável never scans a code from someone else.

phase.description: name: types the name. warning: reads bipe_team_add_warning. code: link-phone-show with this screen's strings. done: the person shows in the list. failed: see error.

continue.effect: From name to warning. Calls nothing.

open.effect: From warning: POST /v1/me/business/seats with the name. seat_limit shows bipe_team_add_limit. Then runs link-phone-show open: GrantLoginWithQrCodeHandler.generate, the check code and the biometric check of link-phone-approve.

progress.effect: When the grant is done: GET /v1/me/business/seats until the seat is active, up to window_expires_at, then done.

expired.effect: The window ended: shows bipe_team_add_expired and DELETE /v1/me/business/seats/{seatId}.

cancel.effect: Before the grant is done: cancels the grant and DELETE /v1/me/business/seats/{seatId}.

notes: No role picker: one owner per account, so every person added is an attendant (ADR 0251 point 22).
The flow starts only from Quem atende. bipe_device_approval_never_for_others stays on device-verification and link-phone-approve (ADR 0251 point 5).
The grant sends the full secrets bundle before bipe-api sees the attestation (bipe-chat/bipe#1053). A phone that fails the check stays a device with no person.
Copy code is off in this flow: the person must see the code in person.
